decision.observation: 8:50 pm, Sat. 6; the rod is in hand but the cast line runs north/up from the farmer, away from the pond south of him. Energy is still depleted (red).
decision.hypothesis: The cast direction is north because the farmer faces up; turning south then casting should place the bobber in the pond water below.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; catches so far: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6). Energy bar exhausted but casts still work.
